fields.label: Doctype
fields.description: The doctype this policy governs. A doctype with no policy, or a disabled one, is invisible to the assistant.

fields.label: Assistant Can Use This Doctype
fields.description: Off = the assistant can't see or touch this doctype at all. Every new doctype starts off.

fields.label: Can Read
fields.description: May list, search and read records (still only ones the signed-in user may read).

fields.label: Can Create / Edit
fields.description: May create and update records (still only what the signed-in user may write, and never a Hidden or Read Only field).

fields.label: Include Child Table Rows
fields.description: Include rows of this doctype's child tables when reading a record - each child doctype needs its own enabled policy, or its rows are left out.

fields.label: Max Rows Per Search
fields.description: Most records one search can return (1 to 50).

fields.label: Field Rules
fields.description: Fields the assistant must never see (Hidden) or never change (Read Only). Passwords, attachments and signatures are always hidden.
